CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchases_juan (
    client_id STRING,
    price DECIMAL(10, 2),
    amount INT,
    discount_applied DECIMAL(5, 2),
    purchase_location STRING,
    purchase_date STRING
)
ROW FORMAT DELIMITED 
FIELDS TERMINATED BY ","
STORED AS TEXTFILE

%hive
LOAD DATA INPATH 's3a://desafio2/purchases_2023.csv'
INTO TABLE purchases_juan

%hive
SELECT 
    p.client_id,
    
    -- Calcular total gasto pelo cliente
    SUM(p.price * p.amount * p.discount_applied) AS total_price,

    -- Encontrar o local mais utilizado para compras
    MAX(p.purchase_location) AS most_purchase_location,

    -- Data da primeira compra
    MIN(p.purchase_date) AS first_purchase,

    -- Data da última compra
    MAX(p.purchase_date) AS last_purchase,

    -- Campanha mais recebida pelo cliente
    MAX(c.id_campaign) AS most_campaign,

    -- Contar quantidade de campanhas com status "error"
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.return_status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS quantity_error,

    -- Data atual formatada como YYYY-MM-DD
    DATE_FORMAT(current_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS date_today,

    -- Data atual formatada como MMYYYY
    CAST(DATE_FORMAT(current_date, 'MMyyyy') AS INT) AS anomes_today

FROM 
    purchases_juan p
LEFT JOIN 
    campanhas_juan c ON p.client_id = c.client_id

GROUP BY 
    p.client_id
ORDER BY 
    p.client_id
